command:

printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
id
cat /etc/os-release
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- existing paths ---'
ls -ld /srv/inventory /mnt/inventory 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- existing mount ---'
findmnt -T /mnt/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS 2>&1 || true

command:
set -eu
check_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid)
printf '%s\n' "$check_id" > /srv/inventory/.[REDACTED]
sync
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'mount_unit='; systemctl is-active mnt-inventory.mount
findmnt --mountpoint /mnt/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS

cmp -s /srv/inventory/.[REDACTED] /mnt/inventory/.[REDACTED]
